title: Bathroom Pods
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Pod delivered undamaged with its factory QA and test pack?
Positioned and levelled to setting-out, packers as specified?
Drainage air test to 38 mm water gauge before final connections, no loss?
questions.source: SBE pod ITP – drainage air test

questions.q: Manifold and shower mixer pressure tested at 6 bar for 60 min?
questions.source: SBE pod ITP – water integrity test

questions.q: Towel rail earthing tested to prove RCD compliance?
Off-site: water system air test 0.5 bar 30 min, then water 6 bar 60 min; siphons tested at 3.8 mbar for 3 min?
Pod fixing bolts protruding the specified amount (11 / 21 mm ±2 mm)?
Water, waste and electrics connected on site and checked for leaks?
Pod finishes undamaged and protected after connection?
